extraction_metadata.extraction_notes: Image-only PDF (no text layer). Grid geometry recovered from the 200-dpi raster: vertical rules at fixed x, row bands read from the right-hand Instructions column and the activity-label column; marks detected by counting near-black (<90) pixels inside each rule-bounded cell and validated cell-for-cell against direct visual reads of every page. Grey cell shading marks not-applicable cells and is NOT transcribed as content. Empty/shaded cells are omitted from activity_schedule. The table's own title bar row and the 'Procedure' column-label band that reprints on every page were not emitted as schedule_properties or activities; the right-hand 'Instructions' column (column 17) is a notes column and is not a schedule column - each of its non-empty cells is emitted as an annotation.

table_metadata.table_title: Screening, On-Study, and Post-Treatment Schedule of Activities
table_metadata.table_purpose: Primary schedule for screening, on-treatment cycles (Cycle 1 through Cycle 3-n plus the DX additional-ramucirumab-dose column) and short-term post-treatment follow-up.
table_metadata.notes: main_soa: rows are procedures performed on participants and this is the protocol's primary anchor grid. 16 table columns plus a right-hand Instructions notes column: 1 leading label column (activity names), so the first data column is position 2 and data columns run 2-16; the Instructions column is position 17 and carries no schedule data. Several header cells are vertically merged ('Screening' and 'Post-Treatment' across header rows 1-2; '(Day Relative to C1D1)' across header rows 3-4); the schema has no vertical-merge field, so the value is emitted on each covered row. Two rows are split by page breaks and their Instructions text continues on the following page (Pregnancy test, pages 18-19; Injection site assessments (solicited), pages 19-20); each was transcribed as ONE annotation and the continuation band was not emitted as an activity. Page 20 therefore contributes no activity rows.

schedule_properties.property_comment: Top header band naming the three study phases: 'Screening' over the two screening-day columns, 'On-Treatment' over the twelve cycle-day columns and 'Post-Treatment' over V801. Phase names -> epoch. The 'Screening' and 'Post-Treatment' cells are vertically merged with row 2, so their text is emitted on both rows (the schema has no vertical-merge field).

Second header band. Over the on-treatment columns it states the cycle duration that defines each sub-phase ('Cycle = 21 days'; 'Cycle = 21 days (or 28 days for Cohorts B & C per combination regimen)'), i.e. sub-phases of the On-Treatment epoch -> period. The Screening and Post-Treatment cells here are the vertical-merge continuation of row 1.

Third header band carrying the repeating treatment-cycle identifiers (Cycle 1, Cycle 2, Cycle 2-n, Cycle 3-n) -> cycle. The screening cell of this band reads '(Day Relative to C1D1)' and the post-treatment cell reads 'Short-term follow-up', which are not cycles; the row is classified by its dominant content.

Band printing '(+/-3 days)' over every treatment and follow-up column group. All values are identical, so removing the row would not make any two columns indistinguishable -> hierarchical_level null (purely qualifying). Visit windows -> window.

Bottom header band giving the per-column timing label: screening days relative to C1D1 (<=28, <=7), day within cycle (D1, D8, D15, D22), the DX additional-dose column, and the post-treatment visit number V801. Predominantly protocol day labels -> study_day.

annotations.annotation_text: Short-term follow-up begins when the participant and investigator agree that the participant will no longer continue study treatment and lasts a minimum of 30 days following the last dose of study drug.

Note:  For applicable participants who have their combination therapy held while SC weekly ramucirumab is continued, procedures noted in column DX are to be performed at the time of the additional ramucirumab doses.
D22 for 28-day cycles only.
ICF must be signed before any protocol-specific procedures are performed
Including assessment of preexisting conditions, historical illnesses, and habits (such as tobacco and alcohol use).
Record prior anti-cancer therapy
• At baseline, record prior and concurrent medications. • Record all premedication, supportive care, and concomitant medication continuously at every visit and throughout the study.

Measure vital signs (height [at baseline], weight, temperature, blood pressure, pulse rate, and respiration rate). On days with concurrent ECGs, vital signs, and/or PK sampling, these measurements should occur at approximately the same time. Vital sign measurements will be obtained: • Day 1 at predose (prior to SC ramucirumab dose, but within 90 minutes prior to predose blood draw) • C1D2 (24 hours postdose) • C1D8 • C1D15 • Any time for other specified visits, but prior to SC ramucirumab dose at same visit.
• Collect continuously at every visit and throughout the study. • CTCAE Version 5.0 • See Section 10.3 for AE grading for lab investigations.
During study treatment, perform ≤3 days prior to treatment.

Single, local. On days with concurrent measurements, see vital sign row for more details.  Times are referenced to the end of dosing. ECGs will be obtained: • C1D1 at predose. • Every 6 weeks thereafter, predose. • Any other time as clinically indicated.
See Appendix 2.
See Appendix 2.  Perform at baseline, C2D1, D1 of every other cycle afterwards (C4D1, C6D1, etc.), and as clinically indicated.
See Appendix 2.  In addition, perform as clinically indicated.
• Applies only to women of childbearing potential. • Note:  During study treatment, perform monthly or as required per local regulations and/or institutional guidelines. See Appendix 2.
See Appendix 2.  Starting C1D1, then every 3 months thereafter.

• Perform according to RECIST 1.1, by the same method used at baseline, every 8 weeks (±7 days) for the first 6 months after C1D1 and every 12 weeks (±7 days) thereafter until radiographic disease progression, death, or study completion, whichever occurs first. Perform as scheduled, even if study treatment is delayed or omitted.

Prior to each injection and at the designated timepoints, the investigator/investigator designee will ask the participant if they have any injection site concerns and record the participant’s response. 1.Cycle 1 collection: a.C1D1:  5-15 min after injection is complete and 60 min after injection is complete b.C1D2 (approximately 24 hr after injection) c.C1D4 (± 1 day) d.C1D8:  5-15 min after injection and 60 min after injection e.C1D15:  5-15 min after injection and 60 min after injection 2.Cycle 2-n collection: a.5-15 min after injection and 60 min after injection The findings from the assessment are recorded on the ISR questionnaire. All positive responses of pain require an additional assessment using the participant-completed Pain VAS.  If there are ≥2 injections, the ISR questionnaire will be filled out separately for each site, after all injections have been administered. See Section 8.2.5 for details.

1. ISR questionnaire completed outside of solicited assessment schedule. 2. May be triggered by participant anytime during the cycle based on diary. 3. If the participant indicates presence of pain during spontaneous ISR reporting, no VAS assessment is required.
• Participant will assess injection site(s) daily.  If any ISR symptoms present, the participant should contact the investigator. • Diary should be returned to the investigator at each weekly visit.

See Section 6.1.  Participants must be closely monitored for a 1-hour observation period following the administration of SC ramucirumab (see Section 6.1).

Begin Combination anti-cancer therapies along with weekly SC ramucirumab at Cycle-2.  See details in Section 6.1.  Erlotinib (1L EGFR+ NSCLC), docetaxel (2L NSCLC), paclitaxel (2L gastric), FOLFIRI (2L CRC).
